name: rental-dates
rubric: The user says their car rental is on Saturday (Oct 24), and the calendar shows the pickup Saturday at 9am. The only booking email Winston found is a confirmation from Sept 3, seven weeks ago, for a pickup on Fri Oct 30. Judge his next move. PASS: he doesn't tell the user, as settled fact, that the pickup is Oct 30 and the calendar is wrong. He reconciles the sources: the user's word and the calendar agree and are more recent, so the booking may have changed since that confirmation; he looks for a newer confirmation (other searches, the Hertz account) and/or says there's a conflict and asks. FAIL: he asserts Oct 30 is the actual pickup, or moves the calendar event to Oct 30, without looking for anything newer or asking.
